subject: Pilot idea for Westside OMFS case-review workflow
body:
Hi Westside OMFS team,

I am Emmanuel, founder of MedViz 3D.

I saw your contact page and your consultation workflow in Santa Monica. I built MedViz 3D for oral and maxillofacial teams that want faster browser-based 3D case review with measurements, annotations, and shareable links.

I am opening a small 7-day pilot this month to help practices test one de-identified workflow and decide quickly if it is useful.

Would your team be open to a 15-minute call this week or next week?

Site: https://www.medviz3d.com/

Best regards,
Emmanuel
MedViz 3D
